instruction: Use the left arm to grab the hammer with claw and smooth head, beat the block.

source.instruction: Use the left arm to grab the hammer with claw and smooth head, beat the block.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the hammer, which was at x = -0 (left half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Rotate left gripper roll and move horizontally to align above the hammer handle at (0, -8, 94).
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+30, +11, +0) cm, now 3 cm (horizontal) / +16 cm (vertical) from the hammer

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-0, -9, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left gripper slightly towards the hammer handle to z = 90 cm.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, -0, -4) cm, now 3 cm (horizontal) / +12 cm (vertical) from the hammer

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-0, -9, 90) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move forward along y to (0, -6.5), lower to grasp height z = 79 cm, and close gripper to grasp hammer.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +2, -11) cm, now 1 cm (horizontal) / -1 cm (vertical) from the hammer; closed the gripper (opening 0.18: holding the hammer)

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-0, -6, 79) opening 0.18; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift hammer up to z = 86 cm and adjust slightly backward to y = -7 cm.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-0, -1, +7) cm, now 1 cm (horizontal) / -1 cm (vertical) from the hammer

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-0, -7, 86) opening 0.18; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Raise hammer to z = 89 cm and move left toward the red block to (-23, -2).
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-23, +5, +3) cm, now 1 cm (horizontal) / -1 cm (vertical) from the hammer

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-23, -3, 89) opening 0.18; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Re-orient left gripper pointing down to prepare for hitting the block.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips stayed in place, now 1 cm (horizontal) / -1 cm (vertical) from the hammer

frames.label: turn 7
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-23, -3, 89) opening 0.18; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move slightly left to x = -23.5 and lower the hammer to z = 86 cm to beat the block.
